description: `retrieval.reindexPlan` when nothing can be priced (S54 T2, SP2/O3): the route exists but carries no price, so cost.state is 'unknown' with the retrieval leaf's own sentence ('the embedding route carries no price') and NO usd member at all — the absence IS the three-state discipline: a bare $0.00 would read as 'free' for a route nobody priced (M30). The figure halves stay honest too: this corpus was never embedded, so willReplaceEmbeddings is false (the pass creates vectors, replaces none) and no embedDim is claimed — the dimension is the row's recorded history, and an empty row has none to state. An estimate with no price is still a complete, renderable answer.

result.estimateBasis: approximately 4 bytes per token over the chunk bodies — the conventional English-text approximation, not a provider's tokenizer

cost.reason: the embedding route carries no price
